The structure of Dy6Fe6 (reduced formula DyFe) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Dy and Fe centers adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, at distances of 2.7815–2.877 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal Dy–Fe and Dy–Dy 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Fe–Fe pairs share corners and edges.
